lead.title: Inference Stack bundles vLLM, LiteLLM, llm-d and Grafana into one command
lead.summary: Inference Stack v0.1.2 launched as a single-command Docker/Kubernetes bundle that wires the common self-hosted serving pieces together: vLLM for inference, LiteLLM as gateway, llm-d for distributed serving and Grafana for metrics. It ships a launcher that searches Hugging Face, estimates GPU requirements, and includes a built-in Playground and metrics dashboards, collapsing the usual multi-tool setup into one manifest.

top_stories.title: Tencent open-sources Hunyuan Hy4, a 770B MoE with 49B active parameters
top_stories.summary: Weights and system cards are public after Hy4 flash (224B/12B active) landed Nov 16; the team's AMA covered training efficiency and distillation-based reasoning.

top_stories.title: Cognition in talks to raise $2B+ at a $75B valuation
top_stories.summary: Per Bloomberg Nov 21, up from the September Series E at $48B; no lead investor named for the Devin coding-agent maker.

top_stories.title: Databricks in early talks for multibillion raise at about $225B valuation
top_stories.summary: First reported by WSJ and followed by Reuters; roughly 20% above the $190B set in the August 2026 round.

top_stories.title: Amazon reportedly near acquisition of AI startup Decart for up to $7.5B
top_stories.summary: Roughly double Decart's previous ~$4B valuation, with founders set to stay on for five years.

items.title: Posterior Matching Distillation compresses diffusion sampling into a few evaluations
items.summary: NVIDIA distills iterative diffusion sampling by matching student output distributions to the teacher, accelerating image/video generation under small evaluation budgets.

items.title: A CPU inside an LLM: zero-gradient compilation of exact circuits into pretrained weights
items.summary: Closed-form, zero-gradient circuit-grafting primitives compile deterministic computation such as exact multi-digit arithmetic directly into pretrained LM weights, no gradient fine-tuning or external interpreter needed.

items.title: Dynamic routing and KV-centric execution accelerate Mixture of Block Attention
items.summary: Extends FlashMoBA with dynamic Top-k budgets and a KV-centric schedule for long-context inference, cutting wasted KV-block computation versus fixed-budget MoBA.

items.title: Task-Calibrated Denoising Allocation adapts diffusion-LLM schedules per task
items.summary: Shows the cheapest quality-preserving denoising schedule depends on task, model and sampler, and proposes TCDA, a deployment rule with an explicit error guarantee.

items.title: Qwen3.6-27B lands on Hugging Face as an Apache-2.0 multimodal release
items.summary: 27B image-text-to-text model with safetensors weights and transformers support; the repo has passed 2.4M downloads.

items.title: Gemma 4 ships quantization-aware training checkpoints for llama.cpp and vLLM
items.summary: QAT builds (-qat-q4_0-gguf, -qat-w4a16-ct, mobile wNa8o8) across E2B/E4B/12B/26B-A4B/31B beat generic Q4 at the same size; the 12B sits at 6.7GB in Q4_0.

items.title: APEX quantization method arrives for MoE models via Agents-A1-APEX-GGUF
items.summary: LocalAI team's Adaptive Precision for EXpert Models applies a layer-wise precision gradient by tensor role to the 35B (3B active) Agents-A1 MoE; 75 GGUF variants under Apache-2.0.

items.title: WeChat releases open-source omni-modal WeMM-Video family in 2B to 35B-A3B sizes
items.summary: Claims open-source SOTA on 120+ video-understanding benchmarks by processing both soundtrack and frames; already in use inside WeChat.

items.title: llama.cpp b12627 fits non-causal batches in one ubatch, fixes Vulkan memset
items.summary: Nov 22 builds also fix a Vulkan memset for unaligned ranges on non-UMA devices; prebuilt binaries on the GitHub release page.

items.title: Show HN: DatabaseDMCP serves per-agent custom SQLite databases over remote MCP
items.summary: MCP-compatible clients query purpose-built databases without local setup.

items.title: Show HN: Keepplain adds git-blame-style provenance for AI-generated code
items.summary: Attributes each change to the specific agent session that produced it.

items.title: Show HN: Security Watch alerts when a new vulnerability hits your exact stack
items.summary: Open-source tool tracking dependencies against security advisories.

items.title: Home Assistant 2026.11: custom integrations reported 'not found' after the HACS-to-Marketplace migration
items.summary: Tracked issue: after upgrading to Core 2026.11.x, custom_components fail with 'Integration not found' even after Marketplace reinstall, while core integrations keep working.

items.title: r/LocalLLaMA proposal: keep private per-machine quality benchmarks instead of chasing tok/s
items.summary: Highly upvoted proposal argues raw tok/s without KLD or output-quality data is of limited value; small private benchmark suites are emerging as consensus practice for picking quants.

items.title: TokenMark snapshot: Strix Halo trades blows with DGX Spark on shared llama.cpp models
items.summary: Across 10 shared model/bit-width pairs, Strix Halo led on three llama.cpp runs, Spark on one, three within 5%; biggest gap was Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B 4-bit at 24.5 vs 18.9 tok/s.

items.title: Omarchy patch hands freed GPU memory back to the system on DGX Spark (GB10)
items.summary: Sets NVreg_EnableSystemMemoryPools=0 on GB10 so memory from a stopped model returns immediately instead of sitting in NVIDIA 615 driver page pools (106.7 GiB was stuck as KReclaimable after a 100 GiB model).

items.title: Renesas pushes RZ/V system-on-modules for faster edge vision AI prototyping
items.summary: Covers camera data processing, on-device inference, high-speed interfaces and power management to shorten the prototype-to-production path.
